# `preferNamespaceImport`

Reports named imports from packages configured in namespaceImportPackages that should be namespace imports

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377146`, `TS377147` |
| Language Service name | `preferNamespaceImport` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/prefer-namespace-import` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"
/**
         ^^^^^^ effecttsgo(prefer-namespace-import): 'Effect' is imported by name from 'effect', but namespaceImportPackages expects a namespace import. Use 'import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"' instead.
*/

export const program = Effect.succeed(1)
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "preferNamespaceImport": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Oxlint Configuration

See the [Oxlint setup guide](../README.md#oxlint-setup) for installation and patching instructions.

```json
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/oxlint-schema.json",
  "options": {
    "typeAware": true
  },
  "plugins": ["effecttsgo"],
  "rules": {
    "effecttsgo/prefer-namespace-import": "warn"
  }
}
```
